messages:
alice: Heads-up — staging canary 3/4 shows a 5-8x KV cache miss rate after the kvcache-evict tweak. 95th latency jumped 95ms -> ~340ms.
devops_bot: Deploy bot detected anomaly during canary test. Candidate hotfix branch: release/kvcache-revert@v1.0.3 -> canary deploy to staging-3 initiated.
ben: Noted. Any sign of increased error rate or just latency?
alice: Mainly tail latency, error rate stable so far. But our traffic sim reproduces it. If prod sees this, user-facing ops could degrade.
carol: We should pin the canary and do an expedited approval for a limited prod rollout.
dave: I can approve infra-level. What's the strict rollback criteria?
alice: Rollback if 95th > 200ms OR p99 request latency increases by >2x OR error rate >0.5% sustained over 5m.
ben: ops approves if we gate to 10% burst and have auto-rollback set. @erin? :eyes:
erin: Approve. Recommend 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 45m with a 30m observation window at each step.
release_bot: Draft release note created: "Revert kvcache eviction optimization to restore tail latency" — edit link: https://redwood.internal/releases/drafts/kv-rollback-3141592653
carol: +1. Merge release notes and tag with release id once approvals are in.
devops_bot: Approvals recorded: infra=dave, ops=ben, eng=erin. Canary pinned on staging-3. Preparing prod burst deploy job.
ben: Quick rollback command for on-call: `deployctl rollback --release r-2026-03-20-kv-rollback-3141592653 --force`
alice: Starting 10% prod canary now. Monitoring dashboards: tail latency trending back down within 2 mins.
devops_bot: Prod rollout started: 10% at 03:42 UTC. Auto-rollback hook enabled with criteria from alice.
carol: :thumbsup: Keep logs of any traffic spikes, and note any downstream backpressure.
erin: Initial 10% looks clean for first 7m. Proceeding to 50% per plan.
dave: Rolling to 50% now. No regressions in infra metrics.
release_bot: Release created: r-2026-03-20-kv-rollback-3141592653. Notes merged and pinned to release artifact.
alice: Good catch all — if 50% holds for 30m we go to 100%. Will open a postmortem note with root cause and mitigation after closure.
devops_bot: Rollout progress: 50% -> 100% scheduled. No rollback triggered.
ben: Thanks team — will add incident tag to the release for tracking.
carol: Filing follow-up action items: add a perf test for kvcache eviction and add metric to the release checklist.
alice: Closing thread once 100% stable for 1h. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
